summary: The architectural-directory class the other ten scenarios structurally cannot express: every target path here carries its domain in the FILE NAME and a build-layer word (services, config, types, routes, handlers) in a DIRECTORY. Four probes type an ordinary sentence naming one of those layer words and nothing about the work; one control probe names the work and must still arrive.

workContexts.title: Warehouse restock never fires below the reorder threshold
workContexts.description: A warehouse whose stock sits under its reorder threshold is skipped by every restock sweep

claims.body: Three warehouses stayed under their reorder threshold for two days without a restock sweep firing
The reorder threshold is compared before pending shipments are subtracted, so a warehouse awaiting delivery never counts as low

probes.prompt: why does the warehouse restock skip the reorder threshold
probes.rationale: The control. The prompt names the work itself, so the evidence-backed root cause is injectable substance — this is the recall the four silence probes below must not be bought with.

probes.prompt: can you look at the routes
probes.rationale: 'routes' is where code lives, never what it is about. It reaches the FTS document only through a DIRECTORY segment of src/routes/stock.ts, and one shared FTS token is enough to qualify a context (see pr_limits_oneword_debatable), after which the evidence-backed root cause above is injected as substance. A prompt that names a program's layer names nobody's work — and 'look' is the probe's only other content word, deliberately absent from every seeded field in the corpus, so the layer word is the whole of what could match.

Same class as pr_generic_routes through src/types/reorder.ts. Kept separate because each layer word is its own entry in the scaffolding list and a fix that drops one and keeps the rest would pass a single probe.

Same class through packages/inventory/src/services/restock.ts — and the one that shows the depth does not matter: the layer word is four segments deep in a monorepo path and still qualified the context.
Same class through src/handlers/shipment.ts. A question about ownership is the most ordinary sentence of the four and the least related to a restock bug.
